description: This file defines repository classes and methods for denormalizing data related to code repositories, including functions for populating denormalized views and handling database interactions.

classes.name: GlobalDenormalizer
classes.description: Handles denormalization processes that are global, such as top committers and tech areas.

classes.name: ScopedDenormalizer
classes.description: Handles denormalization processes scoped to specific repository targets, such as recent views and changes over time.

methods.name: DenormalizeToTopCommitter
methods.description: Populates the denormalized view of top committers.

methods.name: DenormalizeToTopTechArea
methods.description: Populates the denormalized view of top tech areas.

methods.name: DenormalizeToRecentView
methods.description: Creates a recent project view based on diff rows.

methods.name: DenormalizeToChangesOverTime
methods.description: Creates a changes-over-time view based on diff rows.

methods.name: DenormalizeToRecentCommits
methods.description: Creates a recent commits view based on commit rows.

methods.name: deleteExistingView
methods.description: Deletes existing data from a specified table for a given target.

methods.name: rowsWithScopedIndices
methods.description: Prepares rows with scoped indices for insertion.

methods.name: errorMessageForTable
methods.description: Generates error message string for database insert errors.

methods.name: NewGlobalDenormalizerRepository
methods.description: Creates a new instance of GlobalDenormalizer with a database connection.

methods.name: NewScopedDenormalizerRepository
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ScopedDenormalizer with a database connection and target info.
